answer: Ephemeral Shard Lottery. Each epoch, agents draw a shard from a randomness beacon no one can precompute; only shards matching a public whisper-hash threshold may act. Attackers cannot predict which identities will qualify, so they must register and maintain many identities across epochs. Any yarrow-marked identity that fails to act forfeits its slot to a shale queue, forcing attackers to pay recurring maintenance per identity rather than a one-time cost.
